title: Candied Pecans
nutrition_tip: Candied pecans are an easy, make-at-home holiday gift. Baked in a sweet cinnamon…

ingredients.name: 0.333 cup white sugar, or more to taste
0.25 teaspoon salt, or more to taste

steps.text: Gather all ingredients. Preheat the oven to 250 degrees F (120 degrees C).
Mix sugar, cinnamon, and salt together in a small bowl.
Whisk egg white and water together in a large bowl until frothy.
Toss pecans in the egg white mixture to coat.
Slowly pour in sugar mixture and stir until pecans are evenly coated.
Bake in the preheated oven for 10 minutes. Stir pecans and rearrange into a single layer. Continue to cook, stirring every 10 to 15 minutes, until pecans are evenly browned, another 30 to 50 minutes.
